What Is the Roof Express Process for Repairing or Replacing a Roof?

A roofing project should come with a clear plan. From the first inspection to the final cleanup, homeowners deserve to understand what work is needed, how it will be completed, and what to expect along the way.

At Roof Express, we follow a five-step process to keep your roofing project organized and help you feel confident throughout the work.

1. Free Consultation and Roof Inspection

Every project starts with understanding your roof’s condition. Schedule a free consultation online or by phone, and our team will inspect accessible areas for signs of leaks, aging materials, damaged flashing, and other concerns.

We explain our findings and provide a detailed estimate outlining the proposed scope, materials, and costs. Whether your roof needs a targeted repair or a full replacement, you’ll have the information you need before approving the work.

2. Planning, Materials, and Permits

Once you approve the proposal, we coordinate scheduling and material delivery. We help you confirm the roofing system and material selections appropriate for your home and the agreed scope.

Our team also coordinates required local building permits. Permit fees and any exclusions are addressed in your proposal so you understand your project costs before construction begins.

3. Property Protection and Roof Preparation

Before roofing work starts, our crew sets up protective coverings where needed to help protect landscaping, walkways, patios, and surrounding areas.

For a full replacement, we remove the existing roofing as specified in your agreement to expose the underlying deck. This allows us to identify damage that may not have been visible during the initial inspection. If additional wood repairs are needed, we explain the findings and discuss associated costs before proceeding.

4. Roofing System Installation

A dependable roof relies on more than its visible surface. We prepare the decking and install the specified underlayment, flashing, roof-edge components, and ventilation appropriate to your roofing system.

We then install the shingles or low-slope roofing materials according to the selected system’s installation requirements. Particular attention goes to penetrations, skylights, valleys, and transitions where careful waterproofing matters most.

5. Cleanup, Final Review, and Warranty

After installation, our crew removes construction debris and uses magnetic sweepers in accessible surrounding areas to collect loose nails.

We review the completed work, answer your questions, and coordinate any required final inspection. You also receive written workmanship warranty information describing the coverage included in your agreement.

Ready to Get Started?

Roof Express helps San Francisco Bay Area homeowners move through roofing repairs and replacements with clear communication and an organized process. Visit roof-ex.com or 650-666-5554 to request your free consultation and take the first step toward a well-protected home.
